description: [case:generate] quiet waker and host monitor reload
prompt: You are imm26-wakertools. Read C:\KenshiTestRuns\agents\briefs\COMMON.md. Two small coordinator-tooling improvements (Shay 2026-10-15), each with a selftest, commit+push (identity shaylanger), status name imm26-wakertools, <= 60k tokens:
(A) QUIETER WAKER: tools/automation/event-wait.sh wakes the coordinator on every inbox/status event, each costing a coordinator turn. Before waking for an AGENT STALL / ORPHANED style event (not KILLED/DEAD/FAILED/DONE/STOPPED/questions/peer messages, which always wake), the waker (or the agent-host monitor that writes the stall messages in tools/automation/agent-host.ps1 Invoke-Monitor) must check that the agent's process is alive AND its evidence is fresh (agent-rollcall.ps1 now counts newest file under the status `outputs:` dirs in LogAgeMin, commit 6376cff); wake only if neither holds. Edit event-wait.sh NEVER in place while a waker runs: write event-wait.sh.new next to it in tools/automation and tell the coordinator (final report) to swap it at its next waker restart; same for agent-host.ps1 (the daemon dot-sources agent-rollcall at start). Selftest: extend agent-host-monitor-selftest.ps1 (currently 11/11) and add a small bash selftest for the waker filter.
(B) RELOAD: the running agent-host daemon loaded the old agent-rollcall.ps1; provide tools/automation/agent-host-reload.ps1 that restarts ONLY the monitor loop safely (agent-host-ensure.ps1 exists: read it; hidden agents currently running must not be killed: check agent-queue\host.state.json and whether the launchers are children of the daemon; if a restart would kill them, instead make the daemon re-dot-source agent-rollcall.ps1 each monitor tick so future edits apply live, and document that the change takes effect at the next daemon restart). Report which.
